idea-plugin.name: MR Navigator for GitLab
idea-plugin.description:
Review GitLab merge requests right in the IDE, with working code navigation and without generated noise.

  • Merge request list of the project with filters (all open, waiting for my review, assigned to me, mine, merged); repository switcher for folders with several repositories.
  • One-click checkout of the MR into a local mr/<iid> branch; uncommitted changes are stashed and restored by "Go back".
  • Diff whose right side is the real project file — Ctrl+Click, Find Usages and the rest of the navigation work.
  • Hides generated files by suffixes you set (e.g. .pb.go) and folders that contain only such files.
  • Comments: line and multi-line threads, replies, resolve, suggestions, general comments; approve.
  • Files viewed marks and +/− counts; discussion list that opens the diff at the commented line.

Works with gitlab.com and self-hosted GitLab (REST API v4, personal access token with the api scope). The user interface is currently in Russian.
